international.title: Liberal senator Leah Blyth announces defection to One Nation
international.summary: South Australian senator labels One Nation the ‘only party with the bold ideas needed to turn this country around’ Leah Blyth, federal Liberal senator for South Australia, has announced she is defecting to One Nation, becoming the party’s first upper-house member for the state. Blyth, a member of Angus Taylor’s shadow cabinet, said she did not believe the Coalition was capable of opposing the Albanese government, which was “running the country into the ground”.
